cd /workspace && git commit -m "feat: activate kulturhuset in ingestion pipeline
Changes:
- index.ts: Added kulturhuset as source #2 (after stockholm, before ticketmaster)
- sourceRunner.ts: Added runKulturhusetSource() standalone export
- kulturhuset.ts: Fixed date query (use explicit date instead of 'now')
Canonical source: 'kulturhuset' (matches sources.cjs)
Ingestion flow: fetchKulturhusetEvents -> queueEvents -> rawEventsQueue -> normalizer -> Supabase
Verification:
- Kulturhuset API returns 1314 events for today onward
- source_counts in /supabase-events will show kulturhuset once events are queued"
